import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

root = Path('/home/airpig/桌面/hwy/compliance_control/SII_compliance/code/mujoco_6d_vmc_benchmark/outputs/nonrl_ball_coverage_probe_20261029_v6')
output = Path('/home/airpig/桌面/hwy/compliance_control/SII_compliance/docs/evidence/NONRL_INTENT_RECOVERY_20261029/V8_BALL_V6_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION.json')
assert not output.exists()
unit = 'sii-ball-coverage-v6-20261029.service'
cg = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/app.slice') / unit
samples = []
started = time.monotonic()
reason = 'bounded_observer_timeout'
while time.monotonic() - started < 1200:
    raw = subprocess.check_output(['systemctl', '--user', 'show', unit,
        '-p', 'MainPID', '-p', 'ActiveState', '-p', 'SubState', '-p', 'Result',
        '-p', 'ExecMainCode', '-p', 'ExecMainStatus', '-p', 'InvocationID'], text=True)
    service = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in raw.splitlines())
    assert service['InvocationID'] == '0e0eefbcf4154713ae3659ec830a398a'
    state = json.loads((root / 'execution.json').read_text())
    progress_path = root / state['current'] / 'ball/progress.json'
    progress = json.loads(progress_path.read_text()) if progress_path.exists() else None
    resources = {n: (cg / n).read_text().strip() if (cg / n).exists() else None
                 for n in ('memory.current', 'memory.max', 'memory.swap.current', 'memory.swap.max', 'memory.events')}
    processes = []
    if (cg / 'cgroup.procs').exists():
        for value in (cg / 'cgroup.procs').read_text().split():
            try:
                p = Path('/proc') / value
                stat = (p / 'stat').read_text().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()
                processes.append(dict(pid=int(value), start_ticks=stat[19],
                    cmdline=(p / 'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0', b' ').decode(),
                    cpu_ticks=int(stat[11])+int(stat[12])))
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
    sample = dict(utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), service=service,
        status=state['status'], current=state['current'], completed=len(state['episodes']),
        qualifications=[dict(id=e['id'], status=e['qualification']['status']) for e in state['episodes']],
        progress=progress, resources=resources, processes=processes)
    samples.append(sample)
    print(json.dumps({k: sample[k] for k in ('utc', 'status', 'current', 'completed', 'qualifications', 'progress')}), flush=True)
    if state['status'] != 'running' and service['MainPID'] == '0':
        reason = 'original_probe_terminal_requires_full_review'
        break
    time.sleep(30)
with output.open('x') as f:
    json.dump(dict(reason=reason, observer_source=Path(__file__).read_text(), samples=samples,
        limitation='Observer only; qualification and complete direction/movement review remain separate. No simulation or training dispatched.'), f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print('observer_finished', reason, str(output), flush=True)
